description: This file manages loose object indices in a Git repository, including loading, saving, and manipulating mappings between object IDs and their compatibility counterparts.

classes.name: struct loose_object_map
classes.description: Data structure that holds mappings between object IDs and their compatibility counterparts, including hash maps and cache.

classes.name: struct odb_source
classes.description: Represents a source of objects in the object database, including a loose object map and a cache.

classes.name: struct repository
classes.description: Represents a Git repository, holding configuration, objects, and related data.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_init(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Initializes a new loose_object_map structure, allocating hash maps for ID mappings.

methods.name: int insert_oid_pair(kh_oid_map_t * map,const struct object_id * key,const struct object_id * value)
methods.description: Inserts a pair of object IDs into a hash map, ensuring proper copying and storage.

methods.name: int insert_loose_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Inserts a mapping between a regular object ID and a compatibility object ID within a source's loose map.

methods.name: int load_one_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo,struct odb_source * source)
methods.description: Loads the loose object map from disk for a given repository source.

methods.name: int repo_read_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Reads and loads the loose object map for the entire repository.

methods.name: int repo_write_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Writes the current loose object map to disk.

methods.name: int write_one_object(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Appends a single object ID mapping to the loose object index file.

methods.name: int repo_add_loose_object_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Adds a new object ID mapping to the loose object map and persists it if necessary.

methods.name: int repo_loose_object_map_oid(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped object ID from the loose object map given a source ID.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_clear(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Clears and frees all memory associated with a loose object map.
